capabilities: Analyze chapters for threads, characters, and rules
Track foreshadowing from plant to payoff
Track reader knowledge separately from character knowledge
Re-analyze only chapters affected by edits
extras: Analysis runs on Penseed's servers and consumes credits; chapters must be analyzed in order from chapter one. Full foreshadowing-board editing lives in the companion web app. Note text is sent to Penseed for analysis; saving chapter text is optional and off by default.
problem: Long manuscripts make typical writing tools slow, costly, and forgetful, while foreshadowing, contradictions, and reader knowledge go untracked.

relations.evidence: kept in sync with the web app

summary: AI-powered consistency tracker that analyzes novel chapters to track foreshadowing, characters, world rules, and reader knowledge.
